The user approved page v1 at 2026-11-18T21:26Z, verbatim via Optimize: "approved; proceed." The user then said: "goals approved; now, dig into the code, and figure out what needs to change, consolidate, fold, clean up, organize, be corrected to get us from where we are to the goal. update the proposal with a concrete plan of action, composed into steps that build inexorably toward the goal." The user then approved page v2, verbatim via Optimize: "approved. proceed." v2 keeps storage order as it is (term order): a one-word key (atom, int, float, pid, ref) is found by word equality, as BEAM does, and order is consulted only to place a new key. Atom ids are not stable, so the v1 decisions on atom order are withdrawn. Page: https://claude.ai/artifact/MmnrdprbWQMF24ejqsUaQL (/Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-map-raw-words.html); measurements https://claude.ai/artifact/KASxGisqvtZNq498dbRi8D. User direction: meet or exceed BEAM in all cases; hand-written optimal arm64 first, then make the compiler emit it. Builder: Optimize. Pass rules are judged on bench and pre-registered on the page.

Page v3 ruling (user 2026-11-18, verbatim via Optimize): "a, b approved. continue to stack." Page: https://claude.ai/artifact/MmnrdprbWQMF24ejqsUaQL (decision B).

Step 4, inputs only. A value crosses into the runtime as (stored word, kind). This is one type, agreed with GC (forward(raw, kind) in fz-9x7.11 C1 adopts it), Binary Handling (Bin::of_stored takes it), Callables (fz-yh5.3 builds on it) and JSON. The stored word is the value as stored, literal bit included. For a pid or reference it is the Opaque value word, not the tagged ref word.
- One put and one destination put replace fz_map_put_int/_float/_atom/_atom_ref/_opaque/_ref and fz_map_dest_put_ref. The four-clause Map.put in lib/map.fz becomes one.
- The get is NOT here: it folds into 'fz-sc8.192.13' via the pinned-key pattern (fz-sc8.192.12), because compiled code has no form for a run-time-kinded value other than a reference.
- The two-word lane is modelled on the BinaryCursor lane, and the interpreter's extern width limit rises from 4 to 6 words. The two-register return already exists in both backends.
- An extern with a recipe row over a proven binary need not take the two-lane form (Binary Handling's request).
- Tell Callables if LoweredExtern's shape or extern_wire is renamed.

Builder: Optimize. Start from #753 once it merges, because #748 and #753 rewrite the marshal code in jobs/native.rs, and #753 deletes one fz_matcher_map_get_ref caller.
title: A value crosses into the runtime as a word and a kind
